visible_evidence: Water poured into a measuring cup
Liquid level aligned with a volume marking on the measuring cup

checks.text: Water is measured using a marked measuring cup

steps.text: Place-Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
visible_evidence: Hand setting a coffee dripper onto the rim of a mug
Coffee dripper resting squarely on top of a coffee mug

checks.text: The coffee dripper sits stably on top of the coffee mug

visible_evidence: Coffee beans placed on a kitchen scale
Scale displaying a weight reading with coffee beans on the platform

checks.text: Coffee beans are weighed on a kitchen scale

steps.text: Grind-Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
visible_evidence: Coffee beans poured into a grinder
Grinder operating for several seconds
Coarse, sand-like coffee grounds visible after grinding

checks.text: The ground coffee has a coarse, sand-like consistency
The grinder runs for approximately 20 seconds

steps.text: Prepare-Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
visible_evidence: Hands folding a circular paper filter in half into a semi-circle
Paper filter folded a second time into a quarter-circle

checks.text: The paper filter is folded in half into a semi-circle and folded again into a quarter-circle

visible_evidence: Water poured from the measuring cup into a kettle
Kettle containing the poured water

checks.text: The measured water is poured completely into the kettle

steps.text: Place-Place the paper filter in the dripper
visible_evidence: Hand placing the folded paper filter inside the dripper
Paper filter seated inside the dripper

checks.text: The folded paper filter is placed inside the dripper

steps.text: Boil-Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
visible_evidence: Kettle heating on a stove burner or electric base
Steam rising or bubbles forming as water boils in the kettle

checks.text: Water in the kettle reaches a visible boil with steam or bubbles

steps.text: spread-spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
visible_evidence: Fingers opening the folded paper filter inside the dripper
Paper filter spread open into a cone shape lining the dripper

checks.text: The paper filter is spread open into a cone shape lining the inside of the dripper

steps.text: check-Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
visible_evidence: Thermometer inserted into the hot water in the kettle
Temperature reading visible on a thermometer or kettle display

checks.text: A thermometer measures the water temperature after boiling
The water temperature reads between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or 91-96 degrees Celsius

steps.text: Transfer-Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
visible_evidence: Coffee grounds poured or scooped into the open paper filter
Coffee grounds resting inside the paper filter cone in the dripper

checks.text: The coffee grounds are placed inside the open paper filter cone

steps.text: Pour-Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
visible_evidence: Kettle spout tilted to pour a small stream of water onto the grounds
Coffee grounds visibly darkened and saturated with water

checks.text: A small amount of water is poured over the coffee grounds so they are wetted

steps.text: Wait-Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
visible_evidence: Pouring paused while coffee grounds sit undisturbed in the filter
Small bubbles or foam visible on the surface of the wet grounds

checks.text: Pouring pauses for approximately 30 seconds after wetting the grounds
Small bubbles or foam appear on top of the wet coffee grounds

steps.text: pour-Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
visible_evidence: Kettle moving in a circular path while pouring water slowly into the filter
Water level staying below the top edge of the paper filter

checks.text: Water is poured slowly in a circular motion over the coffee grounds
The liquid level remains below the top edge of the paper filter

steps.text: drain-Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
visible_evidence: Coffee dripping from the dripper into the mug until dripping stops
Dripper lifted off the mug after liquid has finished draining

checks.text: Coffee drains completely from the grounds into the mug before the dripper is lifted

steps.text: Discard-Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
visible_evidence: Hand lifting the used paper filter and wet grounds out of the dripper
Used filter and grounds placed into a trash or compost bin

checks.text: The used paper filter and coffee grounds are removed from the dripper and placed in a waste receptacle
